nvjpeg2kGetCudartProperty.doc:
Get the CUDA Toolkit version used to build the library.

Returns the numeric value for the major version, minor version, or the patch level of the CUDA toolkit that was used to build the nvJPEG2000 library.

value.doc: The numeric value corresponding to the requested property.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kGetProperty.doc:
Get the nvJPEG2000 library version.

Returns the numeric value for the major version, minor version, or the patch level of the nvJPEG2000 library.

value.doc: The numeric value corresponding to the requested property.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kCreateSimple.doc:
Create an nvJPEG2000 library handle with default settings.

Creates an instance of the library handle with default backend and memory allocators.

handle.doc: Pointer to the library handle to initialize.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kCreate.doc:
Create an nvJPEG2000 library handle with custom allocators.

Creates an instance of the library using the input arguments. The user has flexibility to choose the backend implementation and provide allocators.
nvjpeg2kCreate.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kCreate(nvjpeg2kBackend_t backend, nvjpeg2kDeviceAllocator_t * device_allocator, nvjpeg2kPinnedAllocator_t * pinned_allocator, nvjpeg2kHandle_t * handle)

backend.doc: Backend to use. Currently [`nvjpeg2kBackend_t::NVJPEG2K_BACKEND_DEFAULT`] is supported.

handle.doc: Pointer to the library handle to initialize.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kCreateV2.doc:
Create an nvJPEG2000 library handle with extended custom allocators.

Creates an instance of the library using extended allocators that accept CUDA streams and user context.
nvjpeg2kCreateV2.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kCreateV2(nvjpeg2kBackend_t backend, nvjpeg2kDeviceAllocatorV2_t * dev_allocator, nvjpeg2kPinnedAllocatorV2_t * pinned_allocator, nvjpeg2kHandle_t * handle)

backend.doc: Backend to use. Currently [`nvjpeg2kBackend_t::NVJPEG2K_BACKEND_DEFAULT`] is supported.

handle.doc: Pointer to the library handle to initialize.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kDestroy.doc: Release the nvJPEG2000 library handle and resources.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kSetDeviceMemoryPadding.doc:
Set padding for device memory allocations.

After success on this call, any device memory allocation would be padded to the multiple of specified number of bytes. This helps minimize the number of device memory reallocations.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kGetDeviceMemoryPadding.doc: Retrieve padding for device memory allocations.

padding.doc: Current device memory padding size in bytes.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kSetPinnedMemoryPadding.doc:
Set padding for pinned host memory allocations.

After success on this call, any pinned host memory allocation would be padded to the multiple of specified number of bytes. This helps minimize the number of pinned memory reallocations.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kGetPinnedMemoryPadding.doc: Retrieve padding for pinned host memory allocations.

padding.doc: Current pinned memory padding size in bytes.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kDecodeParamsCreate.doc: Create an instance of the decode output parameters handle.

nvjpeg2kDecodeParamsDestroy.doc: Release the decode output parameters handle.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kEncoderCreateSimple.doc: Create an nvJPEG2000 encoder handle with default settings.

enc_handle.doc: Pointer to the encoder handle to initialize.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).
An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).
An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kStreamParse.doc:
Parse a JPEG2000 bitstream from a host memory buffer.

This function is the first step in decoding a JPEG2000 bitstream. It accepts the bitstream buffer on host memory as input and parses the JPEG2000 header information. The parsed information is stored in the stream handle and can be retrieved by the stream query APIs.
nvjpeg2kStreamParse.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kStreamParse(nvjpeg2kHandle_t handle, const unsigned char * data, size_t length, int save_metadata, int save_stream, nvjpeg2kStream_t stream_handle)

data.doc: Pointer to the JPEG2000 bitstream buffer in host memory.

length.doc: Size of the bitstream in bytes.

save_metadata.doc: Reserved for future use. Set to 0.

save_stream.doc: Reserved for future use. Set to 0.

stream_handle.doc: Bitstream handle to store parsed information.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kStreamParseFile.doc:
Parse a JPEG2000 file from disk.

Accepts a JPEG2000 file on disk as input and parses the JPEG2000 header information. The parsed information is stored in the stream handle and can be retrieved by the stream query APIs.
nvjpeg2kStreamParseFile.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kStreamParseFile(nvjpeg2kHandle_t handle, const char * filename, nvjpeg2kStream_t stream_handle)

filename.doc: Path to the JPEG2000 file on disk.

stream_handle.doc: Bitstream handle to store parsed information.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kStreamGetImageInfo.doc:
Retrieve image-level information from a parsed bitstream.

Retrieves the image information defined in `nvjpeg2kImageInfo_t`. This information is useful in allocating output buffers on device memory.

image_info.doc: Pointer to `nvjpeg2kImageInfo_t` to store the image information.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kStreamGetImageComponentInfo.doc:
Retrieve component-level information from a parsed bitstream.

Retrieves the component level information defined in `nvjpeg2kImageComponentInfo_t`. This information can be used in allocating output buffers on device memory. Component level information is useful when the dimensions vary across components.
nvjpeg2kStreamGetImageComponentInfo.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kStreamGetImageComponentInfo(nvjpeg2kStream_t stream_handle, nvjpeg2kImageComponentInfo_t * component_info, uint32_t component_id)

component_info.doc: Pointer to `nvjpeg2kImageComponentInfo_t` to store the component information.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kStreamGetResolutionsInTile.doc:
Retrieve the number of resolutions present in a tile.

The number of resolutions is defined as: `numResolutions = numWaveletDecompositionLevels + 1`. Tiles in JPEG2000 are indexed in raster scan order. `nvjpeg2kStreamGetImageInfo()` retrieves the number of tiles present along both the x and y directions. For tile coordinates tile_x, tile_y: `tile_id = tile_y * num_tiles_x + tile_x`.
nvjpeg2kStreamGetResolutionsInTile.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kStreamGetResolutionsInTile(nvjpeg2kStream_t stream_handle, uint32_t tile_id, uint32_t * num_res)

num_res.doc: Number of resolutions present in the tile.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kStreamGetTileComponentDim.doc:
Retrieve tile dimensions for a tile component.

This function is useful when the tile dimensions in `nvjpeg2kImageInfo_t` are not a multiple of the image dimensions.
nvjpeg2kStreamGetTileComponentDim.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kStreamGetTileComponentDim(nvjpeg2kStream_t stream_handle, uint32_t component_id, uint32_t tile_id, uint32_t * tile_width, uint32_t * tile_height)

tile_width.doc: Tile width for the specified tile component.

tile_height.doc: Tile height for the specified tile component.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kStreamGetResolutionComponentDim.doc:
Retrieve dimensions at a resolution level for a tile component.

The resolution dimensions are computed as follows:

* `res_scale = 1 << (num_resolutions - res_level - 1)`
* `res_width = (tile_width + res_scale - 1) >> res_scale`
* `res_height = (tile_height + res_scale - 1) >> res_scale`.
nvjpeg2kStreamGetResolutionComponentDim.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kStreamGetResolutionComponentDim(nvjpeg2kStream_t stream_handle, uint32_t component_id, uint32_t tile_id, uint32_t res_level, uint32_t * res_width, uint32_t * res_height)

res_width.doc: Resolution width for the specified tile component and resolution level.

res_height.doc: Resolution height for the specified tile component and resolution level.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kStreamGetColorSpace.doc:
Retrieve color space information from a parsed JP2 file.

For a JPEG2000 codestream (.j2k file), this function will retrieve [`nvjpeg2kColorSpace_t::NVJPEG2K_COLORSPACE_UNKNOWN`] since color space information is not available.

color_space.doc: Color space of the parsed image.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kDecode.doc:
Decode a single JPEG2000 image.

Decodes a single image and writes it to the output device buffers. The function is asynchronous with respect to the host. All GPU tasks will be submitted to the provided `stream`. Prior to calling this function, the user must parse the bitstream using `nvjpeg2kStreamParse()` such that the bitstream information is stored in `jpeg2k_stream`.
nvjpeg2kDecode.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kDecode(nvjpeg2kHandle_t handle, nvjpeg2kDecodeState_t decode_state, nvjpeg2kStream_t jpeg2k_stream, nvjpeg2kImage_t * decode_output, cudaStream_t stream)

decode_output.doc: Decode output struct. The struct should be on host memory. The image component pointers should point to device memory. See `nvjpeg2kImage_t`.

stream.doc: CUDA stream. Can be set to 0.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kDecodeImage.doc:
Decode a single JPEG2000 image with decode parameters.

Decodes a single image and writes it to the output device buffers. The function is asynchronous with respect to the host. All GPU tasks will be submitted to the provided `stream`. Prior to calling this function, the user must parse the bitstream using `nvjpeg2kStreamParse()` such that the bitstream information is stored in `jpeg2k_stream`. It is possible to control the decode output using an instance of `nvjpeg2kDecodeParams_t`.
nvjpeg2kDecodeImage.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kDecodeImage(nvjpeg2kHandle_t handle, nvjpeg2kDecodeState_t decode_state, nvjpeg2kStream_t jpeg2k_stream, nvjpeg2kDecodeParams_t decode_params, nvjpeg2kImage_t * decode_output, cudaStream_t stream)

decode_params.doc: Decode parameters to control output (e.g. area of interest, RGB output). Can be set to `NULL`.

decode_output.doc: Decode output struct. The struct should be on host memory. The image component pointers should point to device memory. See `nvjpeg2kImage_t`.

stream.doc: CUDA stream. Can be set to 0.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kDecodeTile.doc:
Decode a single tile within a JPEG2000 image.

Decodes a tile within an image and writes it to the output device buffers. The function is asynchronous with respect to the host. All GPU tasks will be submitted to the provided `stream`. Prior to calling this function, the user must parse the bitstream using `nvjpeg2kStreamParse()` such that the bitstream information is stored in `jpeg2k_stream`.
nvjpeg2kDecodeTile.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kDecodeTile(nvjpeg2kHandle_t handle, nvjpeg2kDecodeState_t decode_state, nvjpeg2kStream_t jpeg2k_stream, nvjpeg2kDecodeParams_t decode_params, uint32_t tile_id, uint32_t num_res_levels, nvjpeg2kImage_t * decode_output, cudaStream_t stream)

decode_params.doc: Decode parameters to control output. Can be set to `NULL`.

num_res_levels.doc: Number of resolutions to decode within the tile. When set to 0, the image is decoded at full resolution. Maximum allowed resolutions in a tile can be determined using `nvjpeg2kStreamGetResolutionsInTile()`.

decode_output.doc: Decode output struct. The struct should be on host memory. The image component pointers should point to device memory. See `nvjpeg2kImage_t`.

stream.doc: CUDA stream. Can be set to 0.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kDecodeParamsSetDecodeArea.doc:
Set the decode area of interest.

The coordinates are relative to the image origin and should be within the tile of interest. If the coordinates are set to 0, the entire tile will be decoded.
nvjpeg2kDecodeParamsSetDecodeArea.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kDecodeParamsSetDecodeArea(nvjpeg2kDecodeParams_t decode_params, uint32_t start_x, uint32_t end_x, uint32_t start_y, uint32_t end_y)

start_x.doc: Left coordinate of the decode area.

end_x.doc: Right coordinate of the decode area.

start_y.doc: Top coordinate of the decode area.

end_y.doc: Bottom coordinate of the decode area.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kDecodeParamsSetRGBOutput.doc:
Enable RGB decode output for chroma-subsampled images.

Enables RGB decode output for images with 422/420 chroma subsampling. It is ignored for other chroma subsampling values. YCC to RGB conversion is based on sYCC, Amendment 1 to IEC 61966-2-1. The color conversion is applied at a tile granularity due to which the chroma reconstruction may not be accurate for tiles with odd dimensions.

force_rgb.doc: Set to 1 to enable RGB output.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).
An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kEncode.doc:
Compress an image in JPEG2000 format.

Compresses the input image in JPEG2000 format and stores it within `encode_state`. All GPU tasks will be submitted to the provided `stream`. The function is asynchronous with respect to the host.
nvjpeg2kEncode.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kEncode(nvjpeg2kEncoder_t enc_handle, nvjpeg2kEncodeState_t encode_state, const nvjpeg2kEncodeParams_t encode_params, const nvjpeg2kImage_t * input_image, cudaStream_t stream)

encode_state.doc: Encode state handle containing intermediate buffers.

input_image.doc: Input image. The struct should be on host memory. The image component pointers should point to device memory. See `nvjpeg2kImage_t`.

stream.doc: CUDA stream for all device operations.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kEncodeRetrieveBitstream.doc:
Retrieve the compressed JPEG2000 bitstream.

Retrieves the compressed stream from the encoder state that was previously used by the encoder function.

* If `compressed_data` is `NULL`, the encoder will return the compressed JPEG2000 bitstream size in the `length` parameter.
* If `compressed_data` is not `NULL`, the `length` parameter should contain the data buffer size. If the length is less than the compressed stream size, an error will be returned. Otherwise the compressed stream will be stored in the data buffer and the actual compressed buffer size will be stored in `length`.
* When `compressed_data` is `NULL`, the API is synchronous with the host.
* When `compressed_data` is not `NULL`, the application should call `cudaStreamSynchronize()` to ensure the bitstream copy is successful.
nvjpeg2kEncodeRetrieveBitstream.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kEncodeRetrieveBitstream(nvjpeg2kEncoder_t enc_handle, nvjpeg2kEncodeState_t encode_state, unsigned char * compressed_data, size_t * length, cudaStream_t stream)

compressed_data.doc: Pointer to the host buffer for the compressed stream. Can be `NULL` (see description).

length.doc: Pointer to the buffer size. The library will update the actual compressed stream size.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kEncodeParamsSetEncodeConfig.doc:
Set the JPEG2000 encode configuration.

Sets the JPEG2000 header parameters defined in `nvjpeg2kEncodeConfig_t`. This function should always be called during the encode process.

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kEncodeParamsSpecifyQuality.doc:
Set quality type and value for lossy encoding.

Allows the application to set quality type (algorithm) and quality value, which controls how good the encoded image should look. Refer to [nvjpeg2kQualityType_t](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kQualityType_t) for the allowed values for each quality type. Will overwrite any existing quality setting.

`nvjpeg2kEncodeParamsSetEncodeConfig()` should be called before this function.

Will return [`nvjpeg2kStatus_t::NVJPEG2K_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER`] if:

* `nvjpeg2kEncodeParamsSetEncodeConfig()` was not yet called
* `quality_value` is negative
* Encoding mode is set to reversible
* Quality type is [`nvjpeg2kQualityType_t::NVJPEG2K_QUALITY_TYPE_TARGET_PSNR`] and HT encoder is enabled
* Quality type is [`nvjpeg2kQualityType_t::NVJPEG2K_QUALITY_TYPE_Q_FACTOR`] and `quality_value` is larger than 100
* Quality type is [`nvjpeg2kQualityType_t::NVJPEG2K_QUALITY_TYPE_Q_FACTOR`] and `mct` = 0 and input color space is sRGB.
nvjpeg2kEncodeParamsSpecifyQuality.signature: nvjpeg2kStatus_t nvjpeg2kEncodeParamsSpecifyQuality(nvjpeg2kEncodeParams_t encode_params, nvjpeg2kQualityType_t quality_type, double quality_value)

return_value.doc: An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).
An error code as specified in [API Return Status Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kStatus_t).

nvjpeg2kStatus_t.doc: Return status codes for nvJPEG2000 APIs.

NVJPEG2K_STATUS_SUCCESS.doc: The API call finished successfully. Note that many calls are asynchronous and some errors may only appear after synchronization.

NVJPEG2K_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED.doc: The library handle was not initialized.

NVJPEG2K_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER.doc: Wrong parameter was passed. For example, a null pointer as input data, or an invalid enum value.

NVJPEG2K_STATUS_BAD_JPEG.doc: Cannot parse the JPEG2000 stream. Likely due to a corruption that cannot be handled.

NVJPEG2K_STATUS_JPEG_NOT_SUPPORTED.doc: Attempting to decode a JPEG2000 stream that is not supported by the nvJPEG2000 library.

NVJPEG2K_STATUS_ALLOCATOR_FAILURE.doc: The user-provided allocator functions, for either memory allocation or for releasing the memory, returned a non-zero code.

NVJPEG2K_STATUS_EXECUTION_FAILED.doc: Error during the execution of the device tasks.

NVJPEG2K_STATUS_ARCH_MISMATCH.doc: The device capabilities are not enough for the set of input parameters provided.

NVJPEG2K_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR.doc: Unknown error occurred in the library.

NVJPEG2K_STATUS_IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_SUPPO.doc: API is not supported by the backend.

nvjpeg2kDeviceMalloc.doc:
Prototype for device memory allocation, modelled after `cudaMalloc()`.

Parameters: pointer to allocated memory (out), size in bytes to allocate (in).

return_value.doc: 0 on success, non-zero on failure.

nvjpeg2kDeviceFree.doc:
Prototype for device memory release, modelled after `cudaFree()`.

Parameters: pointer to memory to free (in).

return_value.doc: 0 on success, non-zero on failure.

nvjpeg2kDeviceAllocator_t.doc:
Device memory allocator interface.

When passed to `nvjpeg2kCreate()`, this structure is used for allocating and releasing device memory. If `NULL` is passed instead, the default `cudaMalloc()` / `cudaFree()` functions are used. When using `nvjpeg2kCreateSimple()` to create the library handle, the default device memory allocator will be used.

nvjpeg2kPinnedMalloc.doc:
Prototype for pinned memory allocation, modelled after `cudaHostAlloc()`.

Parameters: pointer to allocated memory (out), size in bytes to allocate (in), allocation flags (in).
nvjpeg2kPinnedMalloc.signature: typedef int(*nvjpeg2kPinnedMalloc)(void * *, size_t, unsigned int flags)

return_value.doc: 0 on success, non-zero on failure.

nvjpeg2kPinnedFree.doc:
Prototype for pinned memory release, modelled after `cudaFreeHost()`.

Parameters: pointer to memory to free (in).

return_value.doc: 0 on success, non-zero on failure.

nvjpeg2kPinnedAllocator_t.doc:
Pinned memory allocator interface.

When passed to `nvjpeg2kCreate()`, this structure is used for allocating and releasing host pinned memory for copying data to/from device. If `NULL` is passed instead, the default `cudaHostAlloc()` / `cudaFreeHost()` functions are used. When using `nvjpeg2kCreateSimple()` to create the library handle, the default host pinned memory allocator will be used.

nvjpeg2kDeviceMallocV2.doc: Prototype for extended device memory allocation with stream and context.
nvjpeg2kDeviceMallocV2.signature: typedef int(*nvjpeg2kDeviceMallocV2)(void * ctx, void * * ptr, size_t size, cudaStream_t stream)

return_value.doc: 0 on success, non-zero on failure.

nvjpeg2kDeviceFreeV2.doc: Prototype for extended device memory release with stream and context.
nvjpeg2kDeviceFreeV2.signature: typedef int(*nvjpeg2kDeviceFreeV2)(void * ctx, void * ptr, size_t size, cudaStream_t stream)

size.doc: Size in bytes of the allocation.

return_value.doc: 0 on success, non-zero on failure.

nvjpeg2kDeviceAllocatorV2_t.doc:
Extended device memory allocator interface with stream and context support.

Allows the user to provide device allocators which accept CUDA streams and user context. Extended device allocators can be passed as input to the library using `nvjpeg2kCreateV2()`.

nvjpeg2kPinnedMallocV2.doc: Prototype for extended pinned memory allocation with stream and context.
nvjpeg2kPinnedMallocV2.signature: typedef int(*nvjpeg2kPinnedMallocV2)(void * ctx, void * * ptr, size_t size, cudaStream_t stream)

return_value.doc: 0 on success, non-zero on failure.

nvjpeg2kPinnedFreeV2.doc: Prototype for extended pinned memory release with stream and context.
nvjpeg2kPinnedFreeV2.signature: typedef int(*nvjpeg2kPinnedFreeV2)(void * ctx, void * ptr, size_t size, cudaStream_t stream)

size.doc: Size in bytes of the allocation.

return_value.doc: 0 on success, non-zero on failure.

nvjpeg2kPinnedAllocatorV2_t.doc:
Extended pinned memory allocator interface with stream and context support.

Allows the user to provide pinned allocators which accept CUDA streams and user context. Extended pinned allocators can be passed as input to the library using `nvjpeg2kCreateV2()`.

nvjpeg2kColorSpace_t.doc:
Color space values for JP2 files.

Corresponds to the colorspace values which are part of the JP2 file format specification.

nvjpeg2kBackend_t.doc:
Backend selection for the nvJPEG2000 library.

Allows the user to select a different internal implementation. A single implementation is currently supported. Additional implementations may be added in the future.

nvjpeg2kImageComponentInfo_t.doc:
Per-component image information.

Used to retrieve component level information. This information can be used for allocating output buffers.

component_width.doc: Width of the component in pixels.

component_height.doc: Height of the component in pixels.

sgn.doc: 1 if the component samples are signed, 0 otherwise.

nvjpeg2kImageInfo_t.doc:
Image-level information.

Used to retrieve image information which can be used to allocate output buffers.

image_width.doc: Width of the image in pixels.

image_height.doc: Height of the image in pixels.

tile_width.doc: Width of a tile in pixels.

tile_height.doc: Height of a tile in pixels.

num_tiles_x.doc: Number of tiles in the horizontal direction.

num_tiles_y.doc: Number of tiles in the vertical direction.

nvjpeg2kImageType_t.doc: Pixel data types supported by nvJPEG2000.

nvjpeg2kImage_t.doc:
Image container for decode/encode operations.

Contains an array of pointers, one per component, and a corresponding array of pitch values. `pixel_type` determines the data type of `pixel_data`.

pixel_data.doc: Array of pointers to component data in device memory.

pitch_in_bytes.doc: Array of pitch values (in bytes) for each component.

pixel_type.doc: Pixel data type. See [Image Type](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1nvjpeg2kImageType_t) for supported types.

nvjpeg2kImageFormat_t.doc:
Image memory layout format.

Describes how an image is stored in memory.

NVJPEG2K_FORMAT_PLANAR.doc: All components are stored in separate planes.

NVJPEG2K_FORMAT_INTERLEAVED.doc: All components are stored in interleaved order. Not supported when component dimensions differ.

nvjpeg2kHandle_t.doc:
Handle to the nvJPEG2000 library instance.

This handle should be instantiated prior to using any of the decode APIs. It is thread safe and can be used by multiple threads simultaneously.

nvjpeg2kDecodeState_t.doc:
Handle to the nvJPEG2000 decode state.

Stores intermediate decode information. This handle can be reused when decoding multiple images. The user must ensure that a stream or device synchronize CUDA call is made between the decoding of two images.

nvjpeg2kStream_t.doc:
Handle to the nvJPEG2000 bitstream.

Used for parsing the bitstream. Bitstream metadata can be extracted by using the APIs defined in [Parser API Reference](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1ParserAPIReference).

nvjpeg2kDecodeParams_t.doc:
Handle to the nvJPEG2000 decode output parameters.

Used to store the decode output parameters like the decode area of interest coordinates.

nvjpeg2kEncoder_t.doc:
Handle to the nvJPEG2000 encoder instance.

This handle should be instantiated prior to using any of the encode APIs. It is thread safe and can be used across host threads.

nvjpeg2kEncodeState_t.doc:
Handle to the nvJPEG2000 encode state.

Contains intermediate buffers required by the encoding process.

nvjpeg2kEncodeParams_t.doc:
Handle to the nvJPEG2000 encode parameters.

Stores user provided parameters that control the encoding process.

NVJPEG2K_RSIZ_HT.doc: To enable High throughput JPEG2000 Encode, set `rsiz` in `nvjpeg2kEncodeConfig_t` to `NVJPEG2K_RSIZ_HT`.

NVJPEG2K_MODE_HT.doc: To enable High throughput JPEG2000 Encode, set `encode_modes` in `nvjpeg2kEncodeConfig_t` to `NVJPEG2K_MODE_HT`.

nvjpeg2kProgOrder_t.doc: Progression orders defined in the JPEG2000 standard.

nvjpeg2kBitstreamType_t.doc:
JPEG2000 bitstream type.

[`nvjpeg2kBitstreamType_t::NVJPEG2K_STREAM_J2K`] corresponds to the JPEG2000 codestream. [`nvjpeg2kBitstreamType_t::NVJPEG2K_STREAM_JP2`] corresponds to the .jp2 container.

nvjpeg2kQualityType_t.doc:
Quality type selection for lossy encoding.

Can be used with `nvjpeg2kEncodeParamsSpecifyQuality()`.

NVJPEG2K_QUALITY_TYPE_TARGET_PSNR.doc: Quality value is interpreted as desired Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) target. The higher the value, the better quality image is produced. Quality value should be positive floating point. Cannot be used with HT encoder.

NVJPEG2K_QUALITY_TYPE_QUANTIZATION_STEP.doc: Quality value is interpreted as quantization step (by how much pixel data will be divided). The higher the value, the worse quality image is produced. Quality value should be positive floating point.

NVJPEG2K_QUALITY_TYPE_Q_FACTOR.doc: Quality value is interpreted as JPEG-like quality factor (1.0 worst to 100.0 best). Can only be used when the input colorspace is YCC, Grayscale, or RGB with MCT enabled.

nvjpeg2kEncodeConfig_t.doc:
JPEG2000 encode configuration.

Contains parameters present in the COD and SIZ headers of the JPEG2000 bitstream. Not all parameters are supported and some must be set to 0.

rsiz.doc: Should be set to 0 for J2K or [NVJPEG2K_RSIZ_HT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1a664c3ff512b626037b47e964fcee1663) for HTJ2K.

image_width.doc: Image width in pixels. Minimum value 1.

image_height.doc: Image height in pixels. Minimum value 1.

enable_tiling.doc: Set to 1 to enable tiling, 0 to disable.

tile_width.doc: Tile width. Valid only when `enable_tiling` is 1. Should be less than `image_width`.

tile_height.doc: Tile height. Valid only when `enable_tiling` is 1. Should be less than `image_height`.

image_comp_info.doc: Pointer to per-component information. Must be a valid pointer.

num_layers.doc: Number of quality layers. Should be set to 1.

mct_mode.doc: Multi-component transform mode. 0 for YCC/Grayscale, 1 for RGB.

num_resolutions.doc: Number of resolutions. Cannot be greater than image/tile dimensions.

encode_modes.doc: Should be set to 0 for J2K or [NVJPEG2K_MODE_HT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/nvjpeg2000/apireference.html#nvjpeg2k_8h_1a66d1e4ca0abd12a0cde4806ab09d8246) for HTJ2K.

irreversible.doc: Set to 1 for irreversible (lossy) transform, 0 for reversible (lossless).

num_precincts_init.doc: Number of valid precinct entries. Set to 0 to disable custom precincts.

precinct_width.doc: Precinct widths per resolution. Should be a power of 2. Valid only when `num_precincts_init` is non-zero.

precinct_height.doc: Precinct heights per resolution. Should be a power of 2. Valid only when `num_precincts_init` is non-zero.
